And Another Counsel for Petitioner :- Lalit Shukla Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ratnesh Chandra Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Standing Counsel, who appears on behalf of the State-respondents and Sri Ratnesh Chandra, learned counsel who appears on behalf of the respondent no.2.
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with the following main prayer:-
"i. issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus, commanding the opp- parties to allot a suitable land in any of the Yojnas of the Lucknow Development Authority in District Lucknow, in lieu of acquisition of the land of the deceased father of the petitioners, namely Late Abdul Shakoor situated on the banks of River Gomti Mohammad Javed And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Nazul Officer , Lko.

... on 7 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170200024/
1 at Daliganj, Lucknow, to the petitioners, forthwith, in the light of the judgement and order dated 31.10.1986, passed by this Hon'ble Petition No.5911 of 1985 Court in Writ (Jagdish Prasad Srivastava and six others versus State of U.P. and another)."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioners that father of the petitioners was carrying trade in timber/building material/bans balli on the banks of river Gomti in Daliganj, Lucknow along with other persons.
They were removed from the said place.
They filed Writ Petition No.5911 of 1985 (Jagdish Prasad Srivastava and six others Vs. State of U.P. and another.

entities.text: Writ Petition No.5911 of 1985 (Jagdish Prasad Srivastava and six others Vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The father of the petitioners was petitioner no.4 in the said writ petition.
At the time of constructions of Bandh on the embankments of River Gomti, such displacement had taken place and the petitioners were removed without any compensation.

The writ petition was disposed of on 31.10.1986 by this Court directing the respondents to refrain from interfering in the possession of the petitioners over the land in dispute,
till they are evicted from there in accordance with law.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that order dated 31.10.1986 was complied with by the LDA by providing alternative land in Sector FS, Sitapur Yojna, Lucknow to the petitioners of Writ Petition No.5911 of 1985 except the father of the petitioners.
The father of the petitioners continuously approached the authorities for allotment of suitable land.
He, however, died in 1994.
Thereafter, the mother of the petitioners continued to pursue the matter.
She also died in January 2020.
The petitioners submitted a representation in August 2021 to the respondent no.2 and requested for allotment of land to dependants/legal heirs of the deceased Abdul Shakoor.
Thereafter, the petitioners have repeatedly approaching the respondent no.2.
He also filed an application under the RTI Act but received information that enquiry committee has been constituted by the LDA and appropriate action shall be taken after enquiry report is submitted.
The petitioners has continued to approach the respondent no.2 even thereafter but he has not received any information with regard to any report submitted by the enquiry committee.
The last such representation made by the petitioners is dated 8.7.2024.

Sri Ratnesh Chandra has pointed out the application moved by the petitioners under Right to Information Act, which is vague and does not disclose as to from where the father of the petitioners was displaced and to which part of the city of Lucknow, the other similarly situated displaced persons were rehabilitated.
It appears that the petitioners' father was displaced from Daliganj, Bans Mandi but the information provided by the Public Information Officer refers to Sitapur Yojana.

Be that as it may, since the petitioners' representation is pending before the respondent no.2 since 8.7.2024, this petition is disposed of, without entering into the merits of the controversy, with a direction to the respondent no.2 to decide the representation of the petitioners by a reasoned and speaking order strictly in accordance with law, within a period of six weeks from the date a copy of this order is produced before him.
Order Date :- 7.8.2024 Ram Murti  Mohammad Javed And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru.
